name: es-ceuta-melilla-ipsi
description: Calculate ordinary 2026 IPSI in Ceuta and Melilla for producers, importers, service businesses and property transactions under direct assessment. Covers territorial and taxpayer selection, transaction and import bases, city-specific rates, selective input recovery, local forms, payment and refund routes, and dated filing exceptions. Distinguishes goods production from retail resale, service location from invoice address, and recoverable production inputs from service-business equipment. Use for IPSI, Ceuta modelo 001, Melilla 420 or 421, importación, operaciones interiores and property tax points. Determine the actual city, commodity or service classification, establishment, tax point, exemption and assessment regime before calculating. Objective modules and specialist levies require their separately identified evidence.
